# Crawling compatibility proof

Protocol: `stasis-post-0.3-census-v1`

This report compares observable crawl outcomes. It does not claim that Stasis
retains Crawlee's RequestQueue/Dataset implementation, and it makes no speed
claim because Playwright pages and fresh Stasis processes are different
execution units.

## Primary result

- Frozen denominator: 20 pages
- Baseline valid: true
- Candidate artifact valid: true
- Exact equivalent rate: 100.0%
- Supported/equivalent-or-disclosed rate: 100.0%
- Scheduled URL-set Jaccard: 1.0000
